Astral Magic Lv 1.Description: Enables the use of level 1 astral magic: Physical Boon and Mystic Boon. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Astral Magic Lv 2.Description: Enables the use of level 2 astral magic: Evade Boon and Elemental Ward. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Precognition.Description: Prevent foes from gaining first strike or scoring a Brave Attack.

Astral Magic Lv 3.Description: Enables the use of level 3 astral magic: Speed Boon and Magic Mirror. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Astral Magic Lv 4.Description: Enables the use of level 4 astral magic: Physical Ward and Mystic Ward. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Prescience.Description: Spells and abilities augmenting status or granting supportive properties will take effect at the beginning of each turn.

Astral Magic Lv 5.Description: Enables the use of level 5 astral magic: Lucky Day and Elemental Mirror. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Astral Magic Lv 6.Description: Enables the use of level 6 astral magic: Elemental Boon and Elemental Barrier. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Prolong Support.Description: Double the duration of stat-raising effects received by you and your allies.

Limit Breaker.Description: Raise the maximum values for stat-boosting effects received by you and your allies. Only one character needs to have this support ability equipped for the entire party to benefit.

Astral Magic Lv 7.Description: Enables the use of level 7 astral magic: Status Barrier. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scroll.

Holy Magic Lv 1.Description: Enables the use of level 1 holy magic: Heal and Antidote. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Holy Magic Lv 2.Description: Enables the use of level 2 holy magic: Open Eyes and Holy Night. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Holy Magic Lv 3.Description: Enables the use of level 3 holy magic: Blessing and Vivify. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Holy Magic Lv 4.Description: Enables the use of level 4 holy magic: Benevolence and Innocence. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Good Measure.Description: Spells cast in succession against the target will vastly increase in potency.

Holy Magic Lv 5.Description: Enables the use of level 5 holy magic: Benediction and Resurrect. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Holy Magic Lv 6.Description: Enables the use of level 6 holy magic: Sacrifice and Calm. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Brevity.Description: Grants a 50% chance of any single spell being cast having the effect of the same spell cast twice.

Holy Magic Lv 7.Description: Enables the use of level 7 holy magic: Fate. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scroll.

Black Magic Lv 1.Description: Enables the use of level 1 black magic: Fire and Blizzard. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Black Magic Lv 2.Description: Enables the use of level 2 black magic: Thunder and Aspir. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Black Magic Lv 3.Description: Enables the use of level 3 black magic: Fira and Blizzara. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Black Resonance.Description: Black magic damage rises with each ally aside from yourself who has set Black Resonance. Only yourself: No effect 1 ally with Black Resonance: Damage x1.1 2 allies with Black Resonance: Damage x1.15 3 allies with Black Resonance: Damage x1.2

Black Magic Lv 4.Description: Enables the use of level 4 black magic: Thundara and Drain. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Black Magic Lv 5.Description: Enables the use of level 5 black magic: Firaga and Blizzaga. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Pierce M.Def.Description: Ignore the target's M.Def when dealing magic damage.

Black Magic Lv.6.Description: Enables the use of level 6 black magic: Thundaga and Dark. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Group-Cast All.Description: Enable group-casting for magic typically unable to be group-cast. This effect does not apply to magic targeting yourself. *This ability will take priority over certain spellcraft spells.

Black Magic Lv 7.Description: Enables the use of level 7 black magic: Flare. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scroll.

Catmancy.Description: Consume cat food items to wield abilities learned from your foes. (After selecting "Catmancy", select the ability you wish to use.)

Catnap.Description: Have a 50% chance of putting each of your enemies to sleep. [Multi-Target]

Attack Item Amp.Description: Raise the damage dealt by attack items to 1.5 times normal.

Dig.Description: Dig for cat food items in battle. The items you find will vary by area. [Self]

Mislead.Description: Lower your chances of being targeted by enemies to the lowest level possible. [Self]

Learning.Description: Learn certain enemy abilities when they are used against you. Only one party member needs to have Learning equipped for all to benefit from its effect.

Whisker Sense.Description: Get the jump on enemies, increasing the party's chance of gaining first strike or scoring a Brave Attack by 5%. *This effect will not stack even if multiple characters possess this ability.

Cat Mastery.Description: Consumes cat food items to wield abilities learned from your foes. (After selecting "Cat Mastery", select the ability you wish to use.)

Purrfect Stance.Description: Raise your P.Def and M.Def to their maximum values. [Self][Duration: 10t] *The upper limit for P.Def and M.Def is 150%.

Meow to the Max.Description: Increase damage dealt by all catmancy and cat mastery moves to 150%. [All allies][Duration: 10t]

Trample.Description: Deal a crushing blow that deals more damage the closer your HP is to maximum. [Single-target][Damage: 0.75x-1.5x]

Triple Wield.Description: Equip weapons to the head slot in addition to both hands, allowing you to wield three weapons and perform three standard attacks. *P.Atk will be halved for weapons equipped to the head slot.

Weapon Toss.Description: Throw a weapon of your choice at the target. The damage dealt will depend on the attack rating of the weapon. Swords, greatswords, axes, spears, daggers, and katanas may be thrown. Damage dealt will not be affected by the target's P.Def. [Single-target] [Damage: 7.0x] *Weapons may be recovered after battle, or by using the Retrieve Weapon ability.

Born Warrior.Description: Every time you execute a standard attack, your proficiency with your currently equipped weapon will increase by one rank for the duration of the battle. *Arms proficiency cannot be increased beyond S rank.

Retrieve Weapon.Description: Retrieve all weapons thrown during the battle. [Self]

Wild Toss.Description: Throw a weapon of your choice at all foes. The damage dealt will depend on the attack rating of the weapon. Swords, greatswords, axes, spears, daggers, and katanas may be thrown. Damage dealt will not be affected by the target's P.Def. [All enemies][Damage: 4.0x] *Weapons may be recovered after battle, or by using the Retrieve Weapon ability.

Master-at-Arms.Description: Raise arms proficiency with your currently equipped weapon type for the duration of one battle. [Self] *The highest attainable proficiency is rank S.

Wanton Destruction.Description: Unleash upon randomly selected foes a flurry of attacks that deal damage proportional to your proficiency with the weapon equipped in your right hand. [Multi-target (random)] [Damage: 0.25x] *This attack will vary between 6 and 16 hits.

Quad Wield.Description: Equip weapons to the head and body slots in addition to both hands, allowing you to wield four weapons and perform four standard attacks. *P.Atk will be halved for weapons equipped to the head and body slots.

Achilles' Heel.Description: All attacks targeting a specific monster family's weakness will always hit for critical damage.

Dark Bane.Description: Sacrifice 20% of your maximum HP to unleash a dark-based physical attack. [Single-target][Damage: 1.25x]

Blind Immunity.Description: Confer immunity to blindness during battles.

Adversity.Description: For three turns, your P.Atk, M.Atk, P.Def, and M.Def all rise by 10% each time you accumulate damage equal to at least 25% of you maximum HP. *The upper limit for P.Atk, M.Atk, P.Def, and M.Def is 150%.

Blaze of Glory.Description: Upon suffering a K.O., hit all enemies for four times as much damage as a standard attack. This attack will not trigger when K.O.'ed by damage from poison or freeze.

Minus Strike.Description: Damage one target by an amount equal to the number of HP you have lost. [Single-target] *Damage is capped at 9,999 when not using Bravely Second.

Black Bane.Description: Sacrifice 30% of your maximum HP to unleash a dark-based physical attack on all foes. [All enemies][Damage: 1.5x]

Absorb Magic.Description: Triggers at the start of the turn. Nullify damage from magic attacks during that turn and restore your MP by the amount of MP used to attack you. [Self][Duration: 1t] *Certain spells cannot be absorbed.

Dark Nebula.Description: Sacrifice 20% of your maximum HP to unleash a dark-based physical attack on all allies and enemies that deals four times the damage of a conventional attack. [All combatants][Damage: 4.0x]

Life or Death.Description: Your P.Atk, M.Atk, P.Def, and M.Def each rise 50%, but you suffer doom status. [Self][Duration: 5t] *The upper limit for P.Atk, M.Atk, P.Def, and M.Def is 150%.

Rage.Description: Unleash Dark Bane against random targets up to five times, or until your HP falls to 1. [Multi-target (random)]

Funeral Pyre.Description: Sacrifice 30% of your maximum HP to unleash a dark-based physical attack that deals more damage the lower your target's BP. [Single-target][Damage: 1.25x-6.25x]

Undo HP.Description: Revert the target's HP to its value at the beginning of the previous turn. Note that this can also revive the target from K.O. [Single-target]

Undo Action.Description: A single enemy action performed against the target will be reverted. [Single-target (ally)]

Steady MP Recover.Description: Recover 30 MP at the end of each turn.

Purgation.Description: Cancel the support effects regen, stop, and reraise, as well as those that nullify status ailments, raise/lower stats, abate/nullify elements or make targets weaker to them.

Undo MP.Description: Revert the target's MP to its value at the beginning of the previous turn. [Single-target]

Undo BP.Description: Revert the target's BP to its value at the beginning of the previous turn. [Single-target] *Does not affect bosses and other unique foes.

Undo Trois.Description: Increase the time range of all Undo abilities from one turn to three.

Eradication.Description: Have a 33% chance of slaying all enemies outright. Chance of success is unaffected by death resistance, intelligence, or mind.

Ectoplasm.Description: Upon taking damage that reduces HP to 0, enter ghost state instead of being K.O.'ed.

Glossolalia.Description: Gain access to the Tongues command, allowing you to cast spells learned by friends you have registered as if they were your own.

Auto Undo.Description: At the end of each turn, your HP and MP will revert to the previous turn's values. *Effect will not trigger when K.O.'ed, or when it would cause HP/MP to be reduced.

Blazing Wolf.Description: Assume the offensive wolf stance. While in wolf stance, your P.Atk and M.Atk will be raised by 25%.

Stalwart Aurochs.Description: Assume the defensive aurochs stance. While in aurochs stance, your P.Def and M.Def will be raised by 25%.

Wolf Fang.Description: Only usable while in wolf stance. Strike an enemy and transition immediately to aurochs stance. [Single Target] [Damage: 1.3x]

Goring Aurochs.Description: Only usable while in aurochs stance. Strike your foe and transition immediately to wolf stance. [Single-target] [Damage: 1.5x]

Soaring Falcon.Description: Assume the speed-oriented falcon stance. While in falcon stance, your speed will be increased by 50%.

Stampede.Description: While in aurochs stance, have a 75% chance of counterattacking against single-target physical attacks, hitting the attacking foe for damage equal to a conventional attack. This effect is not triggered by reflected attacks.

Muscle Memory.Description: The effects of any stance taken will persist for ten turns even after assuming another stance.

Eye of the Wolf.Description: Start out in wolf stance at the beginning of each battle. However, this will not take effect when fighting successive battles.

Falcon Claw.Description: Only usable while in falcon stance. Deliver four swift strikes against targets selected at random from all enemies. [Multi-target (random)] [Damage: 0.8x]

Bloody Wolf.Description: Assume the offensive wolf stance while increasing your P.Atk and M.Atk to their maximum possible values. [Self][Duration: 10t]

Examine.Description: Display enemy information, including HP, elemental weakness and family. Once you have examined a certain enemy, move the Circle Pad left at any time to view the information again. [Single-target]

Halfsies.Description: Use a single-target consumable item on all party members at 50% of its usual potency. *Select this skill, then the item you wish to use. *Certain items will not have their potency reduced.

Divining Rod.Description: Displays the number of unopened treasure chests within your current area on the map screen.

Dungeon Master.Description: In dungeons, avoid damage and status ailments suffered from traps and hostile terrain. Note that this effect applies to the entire party.

Stand Ground.Description: Have a 75% chance to survive with 1 HP when suffering damage that would result in K.O. Effect will not trigger when HP is already at 1.

Waste Not.Description: Grants a 50% chance of being able to use items in battle without consuming them.

JP Up.Description: Earn 1.2 times the normal amount of job points. Furthermore, this effect will stack with similar effects from items.

Square One.Description: Cancel the support effects regen, stop, and reraise, as well as those that nullify status ailments, raise/lower stats, abate/nullify elements or make targets weaker to them. [All combatants]

Mimic.Description: Perform the same action as the previous one, whether it was your own or an ally's. No HP, MP, BP, pg, or items will be consumed. [Self]

Late Bloomer.Description: Maximum HP, maximum MP, P.Atk, M.Atk, P.Def, and M.Def each rise by 1% for every job you master to level 10.

Possession.Description: Transfer your P.Atk, M.Atk, HP, MP, and soul power and take control of your target. Maximum HP, MP, and soul power will also be increased. While possessing another target, you will be unable to perform any actions. [Single-target][Duration: 6t] *Will lead to game over if all other party members are K.O.'ed or ghosted. *Possession will clear a number of statuses.

Soul Smash.Description: Consume 20% soul power to unleash a powerful physical attack on the target. [Single-target][Base Power: 50][Damage: 1.5x]

Soul Boost.Description: Begin each battle wih soul power already at 50%. This effect will not apply when fighting successive battles.

Soul Blaster.Description: Consume 50% soul power to unleash a powerful physical attack on all targets. [Multi-target][Base Power: 50][Damage: 1.5x]

Guardian Spirit.Description: Gain the ability to accumulate soul power, which can be spent to use certain abilities. Soul power will rise by 25% for each attack sustained, up to a maximum of 100%.

Armor Lore.Description: Raise heavy armor and helm proficiency to S.

Soul Link.Description: Use the soul power of the target instead of your own to perform abilities that consume soul power. Furthermore, the target will gain soul power with every attack sustained. [Single-target]

Soul Mirror.Description: Erect a barrier around the target that reflects physical attacks. [Single-target][Duration: 3t] *Erecting a new barrier will cancel the old one.

Possessed.Description: Transfer target's P.Atk, M.Atk, HP, MP, and soul power to you and prevent that target from performing actions. If used against an enemy, will K.O. target. [Single-target][Duration: 6t] *Will lead to game over if all other party members are K.O.'ed or ghosted. *Possession will clear a number of statuses.

Soul Cannon.Description: Consume 100% soul power to unleash a powerful physical attack on the target. [Single-target][Base Power: 50][Damage: 8.0x]

Twin Souls.Description: Gain access to both characters' abilities when possessing or being possessed by another character. *Abilities cannot be used if the possessee's job level is insufficient. *Using spellcraft or tongues requires the corresponding ability.

Sidewinder.Description: Unleash a powerful physical attack on all selected enemies. Selecting fewer enemies will increase damage dealt. [Selected enemies][Damage: 0.6x-2.0x]

Maverick.Description: Unleash a powerful physical attack against the enemy with the lowest HP at the end of the current turn. [Single-target][Damage: 1.25x]

Warhead.Description: Imbue your weapon with the element of your choice, increasing the damage it deals by an amount equal to the spell's power, as augumented by your M.Atk. *Elements imbued by other abilities and special moves will take precedence over this ability. [Base Power: 20][Damage: 1.5x]

Condor.Description: Enhance your physical attacks so their damage is not mitigated by the Default state, and instead deals 1.5 times normal damage to Defaulting foes. [Self][Duration: 10t]

Harpoon.Description: Enhance your physical attacks to ignore the target's P.Def. [Self][Duration: 5t]

Barrage.Description: The damage you deal will rise with the number of offensive actions taken in a given turn. For each damage-dealing action performed, damage from subsequent actions will be multiplied by a factor of 1.1. If an attack fails to deal damage, no bonuses will be applied.

Sparrow.Description: Strike target with a magical attack based on the P.Atk rating of your right-hand weapon. [Single-target][Base Power: 100][Damage: 4.0x]

Shrike.Description: Fire a bullet into the air that will come down to strike your target the following turn. [Single-target][Damage: 1.5x] *A maximum of five bullets may be fired at once.

Crossfire.Description: Have a 25% chance of following up with an attack when an ally inflicts damage upon an enemy.

Blinding Light.Description: Deal damage to all enemies equal to one half your current HP. [All enemies] *Damage is capped at 9,999 unless in Bravely Second mode.

Sonnenblume.Description: Initiative will be reversed, with the slowest combatants acting first. Abilities that trigger at the beginning or end of turn will also be reversed. [All combatants][Duration: 5t]

Centurion.Description: Converts certain multi-target attacks into single-target attacks that deal double damage.

Spring Awakening.Description: All combatants will be healed at the end of each turn, up to a maximum of 9,999 HP per party. [All combatants][Duration: 5t]

Westwind.Description: P.Def and M.Def values will be switched for all allies and enemies. [All combatants][Duration: 5t]

Winter Storm.Description: Nullify HP, MP, and BP recovery for all enemies and allies. [All combatants][Duration: 3t]

Noble Eagle.Description: Increase P.Atk and M.Atk for enemies and allies to 200%. [All combatants][Duration: 5t]

Citadel.Description: Once every two turns, all allies and enemies will lose 1 BP. This ability will continue to take effect even if the wielder is K.O.'ed.

Cerberus.Description: After every battle, your HP, MP, and status will return to their pre-battle states. *K.O. and other statuses potentially leading to game over will also return.

Dawn of Odyssey.Description: Once every four turns, all enemies and allies gain 1 BP. This ability will continue to take effect even if the wielder is K.O.'ed.

Overlord.Description: All attacks will hit for critical damage. [All combatants][Duration: 5t] *No effect on attacks that normally cannot hit critically.

Stomp.Description: Deal a powerful physical attack. However, your P.Def and M.Def will decrease by 25% for two turns. [Single-target][Damage: 1.25x] *The lower limit for P.Def and M.Def is 75%.

Two-Handed.Description: Double a weapon's P.Atk by holding swords/axes/spears/staves/katanas/greatswords with both hands. One hand must be free when equipping a weapon for this ability to take effect.

Ironclad.Description: Start at the beginning of a turn and raise your P.Def to the maximum level for the entire turn. [Self][Duration: 1t] *The upper limit for P.Def is 150%.

Protect Ally.Description: If an ally with less than 20% HP is targeted with a single-target physical attack, you will take the attack in their place.

Shield Strike.Description: Deal the same damage as a conventional attack and for two turns, raise P.Def by 25%. Available only when equipping a shield. [Single-target][Damage: 1.0x][Duration: 2t] *The upper limit for P.Def is 150%.

Full Cover.Description: Triggers at the beginning of a turn. During the entire turn this is used, when the specified ally takes a single-target physical attack, you will take the hit instead, but only suffer half the damage. [Single-target][Duration: 1t]

Dual Shields.Description: Equip a shield in both hands.

Chivalrous Spirit.Description: Each time Protect ally, Full Cover, White Knight or Iron Wall is used, P.Def will rise by 25% for five turns. *The upper limit for P.Def is 150%.

Super Charge.Description: Strike with a physical attack that converts double your P.Def into attack power. [Single-target][Damage: 1.0x]

Iron Wall.Description: Triggers at the beginning of a turn. During the entire turn this is used, when any ally takes a single-target physical attack, you will take the hit instead, but only suffer half the damage. [All allies][Duration: 1t]

Pay to Play.Description: Spend your level times 50 pg to raise the target's critical rate by 300% for four turns. [Single-target][Duration: 4t] *The upper limit for critical rate is 500%.

White Knight.Description: The ally with the most HP protects you when you suffer a single-target physical attack while your HP is below 20%.

Pharmacy.Description: Spend pg to purchase a recovery item and use it on a single target. (Select the item you wish to use after selecting "Pharmacy.")

Salesman.Description: Force an enemy to buy a consumable item from you at 2.4 times its regular selling price. Chance of success varies depending on the item. [Single-target]

More Money.Description: Earn 1.5 times more money than normal after a battle. Note that this effect does stack with similar effects from items, but will not stack from multiple characters possessing this ability.

Hedge Risk.Description: Halve the damage you suffer for five turns by spending money equal to half the damage. [Self][Duration: 5t]

Takeover.Description: Spend your level times 50 pg to deal damage to one target that is equal to the money you spent. [Single-target]

BP Drink.Description: Purchase a BP recovery item and use it on one target. *Small BP drink (restores 1 BP): 1,000 pg *Medium BP drink (restores 2 BP): 10,000 pg *Large BP drink (restores 3 BP): 100,000 pg

Big Pharma.Description: Restore one enemy's HP and make the target pay pg equal to the number of HP recovered. [Single-target][Base Power: 30] *The amount of pg obtainable from this ability is capped at 99,999 pg per battle. *When fighting consecutive battles, this limit resets with each individual battle.

Payoff.Description: Spend money to buy off the enemy and end the battle. Note that you will still get the usual pg, experience, JP, and items.

Insurance.Description: Upon taking damage from enemy attacks, receive pg equal to half the amount of damage sustained. A maximum of 99,999 pg per battle can be obtained using this ability. When fighting consecutive battles, a maximum of 99,999 pg can be obtained for each individual battle.

Strong Strike.Description: Deal a powerful physical attack with a 50% chance of missing your target. [Single-target][Damage: 2.0x]

Paralyze Immunity.Description: Confer immunity to paralysis during battles.

Inner Alchemy.Description: Cure yourself of the status ailments poison, blindness, silence, dread, and confusion. [Self]

Invigorate.Description: Raise your P.Atk by 25% for two turns. However, there is a 25% chance of failure, in which case you will take damage equal to 20% of your maximum HP. [Self][Duration: 2t] *The upper limit for P.Atk is 150%.

Knuckle Lore.Description: Raise knuckle proficiency to S. In addition, when no weapons are equipped, a bonus equal to two times your level will be added to your P.Atk.

Hidden Dragon.Description: Deliver a powerful physical attack that always comes at the end of a turn. [Single-target][Damage: 1.25x]

Qigong Wave.Description: Deal a powerful physical attack whose damage is not mitigated by the Default state. [Single-target][Damage: 1.25x]

Pressure Point.Description: Deal a powerful physical attack that ignores the target's P.Def. [Single-target][Damage: 2.0x]

Phoenix Flight.Description: Reduce your HP to 1 and convert the amount of HP sacrificed into damage applied to a single enemy. *Damage is capped at 99,999 when not using Bravely Second.

Natural Talent.Description: Raise P.Atk by 100% when nothing is equipped in the right hand, left hand, head, body, and accessory slots.

Crouching Tiger.Description: Reduce all allies' BP by 1 and deal a crushing physical attack. [All enemies][Damage: 4.0x]

Shippûjinrai.Description: Deal a swift attack at the start of the turn. [Single-target][Damage: 1.0x]

Confuse Immunity.Description: Confer immunity to confusion during battles.

Shunshin.Description: Raise evasion to maximum for six turns. [Self][Duration: 6t] *The upper limit for evasion is 150%.

Transience.Description: When you evade an attack counterattack against the attacking foe, dealing the same damage as a conventional attack.

Dual Wield.Description: Negates the 50% penalty to weapons' P.Atk that typically applies when equipping weapons in both hands.

Utsusemi.Description: Evade a physical attack one time. [Self]

Comeback Kid.Description: With each physical attack successfully evaded, P.Atk and M.Atk each rise by 25% for three turns. *The upper limit for P.Atk and M.Atk is 150%.

Ikkikasei.Description: Raise hit count by 100% for that turn only. [Self][Duration: 1t] *The upper limit for hit count is 200%.

Kairai.Description: Triggers at the beginning of a turn. For that turn only, the target of enemy single-target attacks will be switched to the ally you select. [Single-target][Duration: 1t]

Frenetic Fighting.Description: Raise the maximum hit count from sixteen to thirty-two.

Impermanence.Description: Reverse the effect of all attribute bonuses and penalties. If this ability is used again while already in effect, the duration will be overwritten. [Multi-target][Duration: 4t] *Bonuses from special move music, berserk, and fencer stances will not be affected. *The upper and lower limits for attributes are 150% and 75%, respectively.

Bon Appétit.Description: Whip up a variety of confections and feed them to your target to inflict a variety of ailments and enfeeblements. (You will be prompted to select a confection after choosing this ability.)

Harvest.Description: Harvest confectionery ingredients in battle. Items harvested will vary by location. [Self]

Flambé.Description: Unleash a fire attack that damages all foes proportional to each target's current BP. [All enemies][Base Power: 50][Damage: 0.5x-2.0x]

Decoration.Description: Raise target's likelihood of being targeted by the enemy to the highest level possible. [Single-target][Duration: 10t]

Status Ailment Amp.Description: Chance of inflicting status ailments will be increased by 25%.

Glacé.Description: The effect of consumable items that restore HP and MP will be doubled.

Digestion.Description: Removes ghost status and any attribute bonuses. [Multi-target]

Prolong Enfeeble.Description: Status afflictions inflicted by characters with this support ability will last for twice their normal duration.

Items for All.Description: Consumable items and Bon Appétit abilities will affect all allies or enemies. *Certain items will not be affected.

Critical Hitter.Description: Have a 25% chance of scoring critical hits with spells and attack items, dealing double damage or doubling recovery effects.

Piestorm.Description: Toss four pies at random enemies, with each lowering a different attribute (P.Atk, P.Def, M.Atk, M.Def) by 25%. [Multi-target (random)][Duration: 4t] *The lower limit for P.Atk, P.Def, M.Atk, and M.Def are 75% each.

Love Power.Description: Raise all targets' P.Atk by 20%. [Multi-target][Duration: 4t] *The upper limit for P.Atk is 150%.

One More for You.Description: Raise target's BP by one. Cannot target self. [Single-target]

Got Your Back.Description: Raise all targets' P.Def by 20%. [Multi-target][Duration: 4t] *The upper limit for P.Def is 150%.

Encore.Description: Have a 25% chance of following up any singing ability used with another singing ability chosen at random from those you have learned. *One More for You and Zero Sum will neither trigger nor be triggered by this effect.

Key to Your Heart.Description: Raise all targets' M.Def by 20%. [Multi-target][Duration: 4t] *The upper limit for M.Def is 150%.

Little Devil.Description: Raise all targets' M.Atk by 20%. [Multi-target][Duration: 4t] *The upper limit for M.Atk is 150%.

Power Up.Description: For five turns, your P.Atk, M.Atk, P.Def, and M.Def will each rise 5% at the end of each turn. *The upper limit for P.Atk, M.Atk, P.Def, and M.Def is 150%.

Zero Sum.Description: Reduce BP to zero for all targets who have one or more BP. [Multi-target]

My Hero.Description: Raise all allies' BP by 1. [All allies]

Hearts♥On♥Fire.Description: Raise all targets' P.Atk and M.Atk by 25% each. [Multi-target][Duration: 5t] *The upper limit for P.Atk and M.Atk is 150%.

The Grand Ship.Description: Raise all targets' P.Def and M.Def by 25% each. [Multi-target][Duration: 5t] *The upper limit for both P.Def and M.Def is 150%.

Double Damage.Description: Deal two times the damage of a conventional attack to one target. [Single-target][Damage: 2.0x]

Provoke.Description: Raise your chances of being targeted by enemies to the highest level possible. [Self]

Shell Split.Description: Deal the same damage as a conventional attack to one target, and for four turns, lower the target's P.Def by 25%. [Single-target][Damage: 1.0x][Duration: 4t] *The lower limit for P.Def is 75%.

Scale Strip.Description: Deal the same damage as a conventional attack to one target, and for four turns, lower the target's M.Def by 25%. [Single-target][Damage: 1.0x][Duration: 4t] *The lower limit for M.Def is 75%.

Shin Smash.Description: Deal the same damage as a conventional attack to one target, and for four turns, lower the target's speed by 25%. [Single-target][Damage: 1.0x][Duration: 4t] *The lower limit for speed is 75%.

Adrenaline Rush.Description: For five turns, P.Atk and P.Def each rise by 50% when your HP falls below 20% of maximum. *The upper limit for P.Atk and P.Def is 150%.

Defang.Description: Deal the same damage as a conventional attack to one target, and for four turns, lower the target's P.Atk by 25%. [Single-target][Damage: 1.0x][Duration: 4t] *The lower limit for P.Atk is 75%.

Skull Bash.Description: Deal the same damage as a conventional attack to one target, and for four turns, lower the target's M.Atk by 25%. [Single-target][Damage: 1.0x][Duration: 4t] *The lower limit for M.Atk is 75%.

Amped Strike.Description: Deal four times the damage of a conventional attack to one target. [Single-target][Damage: 4.0x]

Bully.Description: Increases damage dealt by 10% for every status affliction your target currently suffers from.

Berserk.Description: Enter berserk mode. While in berserk mode, your P.Atk will be increased by 50%, and you will repeatedly perform conventional attacks. [Self][Duration: 6t] *The P.Atk bonus provided by berserk will stack with similar bonuses.

Targeting.Description: Deal a physical attack that always strikes for critical damage. [Single-target][Damage: 1.0x]

Bug Slayer.Description: Deal 1.5 times the damage of a conventional attack to members of the bug family. Does not stack with similar bonuses granted by weapons. [Single-target]

Plant Slayer.Description: Deal 1.5 times the damage of a conventional attack to members of the plant family. Does not stack with similar bonuses granted by weapons. [Single-target]

Beast Slayer.Description: Deal 1.5 times the damage of a conventional attack to members of the beast family. Does not stack with similar bonuses granted by weapons. [Single-target]

Aquatic Slayer.Description: Deal 1.5 times the damage of a conventional attack to members of the aquatic family. Does not stack with similar bonuses granted by weapons. [Single-target]

Precision.Description: When all conventional attacks hit, damage will increase proportional to hit count. Damage will be multiplied by a factor of 1.03 for each attack that connects.

Dragon Slayer.Description: Deal 1.5 times the damage of a conventional attack to members of the dragon family. Does not stack with similar bonuses granted by weapons. [Single-target]

Multiburst.Description: Unleash four physical attacks that randomly target enemies, dealing 0.6 times the damage of a conventional attack.

Savage Beast.Description: When in berserk status, have an 80% chance of unleashing certain physical attack abilities without paying their typical activation cost. *Abilities will be selected at random. *Using an ability will consume 1 BP.

B/W Magic Lv 1.Description: Enables the use of level 1 white magic and black magic: Cure, Aero, Fire, and Blizzard. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

B/W Magic Lv 2.Description: Enables the use of level 2 white magic and black magic: Esuna, Raise, Thunder, and Aspir. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Turn Tables.Description: Raise BP by one when evading an enemy attack.

B/W Magic Lv 3.Description: Enables the use of level 3 white magic and black magic: Cura, Aerora, Fira, and Blizzara. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

BP Recovery.Description: Raise BP by one when sustaining a status ailment.

B/W Magic Lv 4.Description: Enables the use of level 4 white magic and black magic: Curada, Esunaga, Thundara, and Drain. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Revenge.Description: Have a 25% chance to gain 1 BP upon taking damage. Damage from poison and freeze will not trigger this ability.

Revival.Description: Has a 75% chance to raise your BP by two when your HP falls below 20%. Using abilities that consume your own HP will not trigger this effect.

MP Free in a Pinch.Description: Reduces MP cost for spells to zero when your HP is below 20%.

In the Red.Description: Raise damage dealt by magic spells when you have negative BP. 0 BP or more: No effect -1 BP: x1.2 damage -2 BP: x1.3 damage -3 BP: x1.4 damage -4 BP: x1.5 damage

Chainspell.Description: Spells cast will trigger twice. *Has no effect on Wall or Mist spells.

Summoning Lv 1.Description: Enables the use of level 1 summoning: Hresvelgr and Deus Ex. Note that you must acquire the respective summoned beasts in order to summon them.

Summoning Lv 2.Description: Enables the use of level 2 summoning: Ziusudra's Sin and Promethean Fire. Note that you must acquire the respective summoned beasts in order to summon them.

Summon Substitute.Description: When you suffer a K.O., a random summoning spell that you have learned is invoked without consuming any MP. Note that this effect will not trigger in the case of a K.O. from poison or freezing damage.

Summoning Lv 3.Description: Enables the use of level 3 summoning: Girtablulu and Charybdis. Note that you must acquire the respective summoned beasts in order to summon them.

Convert MP.Description: Restore MP equal to 5% of the damage sustained. This effect is not triggered by damage from poison or freezing.

Summon in Pinch.Description: When your HP falls to critical, a summoning spell you have learned is randomly invoked without consuming any MP. Note that this effect is not triggered by poison or freezing.

Summoning Amp.Description: Increases both the MP cost and damage dealt by summoning spells by a factor of x1.25.

Summoning Lv 4.Description: Enables the use of level 4 summoning: Amaterasu and Susano-o. Note that you must acquire the respective summoned beasts in order to summon them.

Summoning Surge.Description: Each time summon magic is used in combat, damage dealt is increased by a factor of x1.1. Note that the same summon magic does not have to be used for this to take effect.

Summoning Lv 5.Description: Enables you to invoke the strength of summoned beasts to augment your own powers.

Nothing Ventured.Description: Triggers at start of turn. If hit by a physical attack during the turn this ability is used, halves the damage you sustain and counterattacks with double the damage of a conventional attack. Also greatly increases your chance of being targeted by foes. [Single-target][Damage: 2.0x]

Squeaky Wheel.Description: Reduce the target's BP by one. For certain foes, including bosses, the success rate falls to 30%.

Multitask.Description: Have a 33% chance to follow up with an additional attack when making a conventional attack.

Counter.Description: Have a 60% chance to counterattack when taking a single-target physical attack. Does damage to a single target equal to a conventional attack. This effect does not trigger for reflected attacks.

Before Swine.Description: Triggers at start of turn. If hit by a magic attack during the turn this ability is used, halves the damage you sustain and counterattacks for three times the damage of a conventional attack. Also greatly increases your chance of being targeted by foes. Does not apply to reflected magic damage. [Single-target][Damage: 3.0x]

Counter Amp.Description: Raise the damage dealt by counterattacks to 1.5 times normal.

The Worm Turns.Description: Triggers at start of turn. If hit by an enemy attack when your HP is below 20% of maximum, counterattack for 7.5 times the damage of a conventional attack. Also greatly increases your chance of being targeted by foes. Does not apply to reflected magic damage. [Single-target][Damage: 7.5x]

Redoubled Effort.Description: The higher your BP, the more the power of your physical attacks rises. 0 BP or less: no effect 1 BP: x1.1 2 BP: x1.21 3 BP: x1.33 4 BP: x1.46

Free Lunch.Description: Spells you cast will consume no MP for two turns. [Self][Duration: 2t]

Eye for an Eye.Description: Triggers at start of turn. Whenever one of your allies takes damage, counterattack with a powerful physical attack. Does not apply to reflected magic damage. [Single-target][Damage: 4.0x]

Rampart.Description: Form a shield around yourself and allies that prevents one physical attack. [All Allies]

Giant Slayer.Description: A physical attack that does more damage the higher your target's BP. [Single-target][Damage: 2.0x-6.0x]

Charm Immunity.Description: Confer immunity to charm during battles.

Radiant Blast.Description: Unleash a light-based physical attack that ignores Default's damage reduction effect. [Single-target][Damage: 1.75x]

BP Limit Up.Description: Raise the BP limit by one, allowing you to store a maximum of 4 BP.

Desperation.Description: Attack by adding the value of your P.Def to your P.Atk. However, your P.Def will be reduced to its minimum for that turn. The damage dealt by this attack will not be mitigated by physical defense. [Single-target][Damage: 1.0x] *The lower limit for P.Def is 75%.

Fortitude.Description: Gain 1 BP for each attack sustained while Defaulting.

Default Guard.Description: Improve damage reduction when Defaulting from 50% to 75%.

Heaven's Gate.Description: Unleash a light attack that strikes random enemies and deals damage proportional to your BP. [Multi-target (random)][Damage: 0.05x] *Hit count and damage vary with user's BP. (1 to 99 hits)

Weapon Guard.Description: If you are hit by a non-magic attack in the same turn that you perform a physical attack with a weapon equipped, damage suffered is reduced by 25%.

Steal.Description: Steal an item from target enemy with a 50% chance of success. [Single-target]

Steal Breath.Description: Attack the enemy and recover HP equal to the damage you dealt. Note that if used against an undead foe, both you and your target will suffer damage. [Single-target][Damage: 1.0x]

Mug.Description: Attack the enemy and have a 50% chance of stealing an item in the process. [Single-target][Damage: 1.0x]

Steal Mind.Description: Attack the enemy and recover MP equal to the damage you dealt. Note that if used against an undead foe, both you and your target will lose MP. [Single-target][Damage: 0.1x]

Godspeed Strike.Description: Unleash an attack that substitutes speed for P.Atk and ignores the target's P.Def. [Single-target][Damage: 5.0x]

Big Bad Burglar.Description: Raise P.Atk by 25% when stealing an item from an enemy or recovering HP/MP with Steal Breath or Steal Mind. *The upper limit for P.Atk is 150%.

Rob Blind.Description: When stealing, obtain two items instead of one.

Shake Down.Description: Steal an item from all enemies with a 50% success rate for each. [All enemies]

Prince of Thieves.Description: Steal a rare (typically unstealable) item from target enemy with a 25% chance of success. [Single-target]

Time Magic Lv 1.Description: Enables the use of level 1 time magic: Haste and Quake. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Stop Immunity.Description: Confer immunity to stop during battles.

Time Magic Lv 2.Description: Enables the use of level 2 time magic: Regen and Quick. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Slow Parry.Description: Has a 60% chance to lower attacker's speed by 50% when taking a single-target physical attack. *The lower limit for speed is 75%.

Time Magic Lv 3.Description: Enables the use of level 3 time magic: Quara and Gravity. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Time Slip.Description: Return to the start of a battle if the entire party is wiped out. Note that even if multiple characters have this support ability, the effect will only trigger once per battle. *Any SP used in battle will not be returned.

Time Magic Lv 4.Description: Enables the use of level 4 time magic: Comet and Hastega. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Time Magic Lv 5.Description: Enables the use of level 5 time magic: Stop and Quaga. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Time Magic Lv 6.Description: Enables the use of level 6 time magic: Reraise and Meteor. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Time Magic Lv 7.Description: Enables the use of level 7 time magic: Quickga. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scroll.

Crescent Moon.Description: Unleash a physical attack on all enemies that deals the same damage as a conventional attack. [All enemies][Damage: 1.0x]

Jump.Description: Jump out of the screen at the end of the turn and then come hurtling down on a foe during the next turn. Damage is increased by an additional 50% if a spear is equipped. [Single-target][Damage: 2.0x]

Land.Description: Land is associated with jumping, a failed Jump will return the user to their original position due to the lack of a valid target.

Spirit Barrier.Description: Become impervious to damage for ten turns by sacrificing MP equal to 10% of the damage you have suffered. [Self][Duration: 10t]

Soul Mates.Description: For five turns, P.Atk and M.Atk both rise by 25% each time an ally suffers a K.O. *The upper limit for P.Atk and M.Atk is 150%.

Soul Crush.Description: Reduce one enemy's MP by one-tenth the damage dealt by a conventional attack. [Single-target][Damage: 0.1x]

Pierce Default.Description: Your attacks' damage will not be reduced by the target's Default state.

High Jump.Description: Jump off the screen and come hurtling down the next turn to deal three times the damage of a conventional attack. Damage is increased by an additional 50% if a spear is equipped. [Single-target][Damage: 3.0x]

BP Skill Amp.Description: Raises the BP cost of abilities that consume BP by one, and increases the damage they deal by 1.5 times.

Super Jump.Description: Jump off the screen and then come hurtling down two turns later to deal double the damage of a conventional attack to all enemies. Damage is increased by an additional 50% if a spear is equipped. [All enemies][Damage: 2.0x]

Quickening.Description: The time delay between execution of jump-based abilities and the resulting attack will be reduced by one turn.

White Magic Lv 1.Description: Enables the use of level 1 white magic: Cure and Aero. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Angelic Ward.Description: Has a 50% chance to halve the damage received, regardless of whether it is a single-target or multiple-target attack. This effect will not be triggered by poison or freezing damage, and will be triggered but have no effect against certain special abilities.

White Magic Lv 2.Description: Enables the use of level 2 white magic: Esuna and Raise. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

White Magic Lv 3.Description: Enables the use of level 3 white magic: Cura and Aerora. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

White Magic Lv 4.Description: Enables the use of level 4 white magic: Curada and Esunaga. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Silence Immunity.Description: Confer immunity to silence during battles.

White Magic Lv 5.Description: Enables the use of level 5 white magic: Curaga and Aeroga. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Group-Cast Master.Description: Cast single-target spells on all targets without suffering any penalty to potency. This effect will apply when casting spells from the menu as well as in battle.

White Magic Lv 6.Description: Enables the use of level 6 white magic: Arise and Holy. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Circle of Life.Description: Upon suffering a K.O., and bring back all allies from K.O and restore all their HP. If multiple characters have this support ability, the effect will occur once per battle for each character, and will occur even if all characters suffer a K.O at the same time. *The maximum value for HP healed is 9,999.

White Magic Lv 7.Description: Enables the use of level 7 white magic: Raise All. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scroll.

Spirit Magic.Description: Enables the use of spirit magic: Heat, Frost, Lightning, Tornado, Soil, Shining, Shadow, and Spirit. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scrolls.

Spellcraft Lv 1.Description: Enables the use of level 1 spellcraft: Dart and Needle.

Damage Dispersion.Description: Disperse 15% of damage to each ally when hit by a single-target attack and sustain the remaining damage yourself. Does not apply to reflected magic damage or damage caused by poison or freeze.

Spellcraft Lv 2.Description: Enables the use of level 2 spellcraft: Hammer and Mist.

Spellcraft.Description: Gain access to the Spellcraft command.

Spellcraft Lv 3.Description: Enables the use of level 3 spellcraft: Blast and Wall.

Absorb M.Damage.Description: Recover HP equal to 25% of the damage taken from a magic attack. This effect is not triggered by damage from poison or freeze, nor by damage that results in a K.O.

Full Charge.Description: Doubles the potency of offensive magic when MP is at full capacity.

Spellcraft Lv 4.Description: Enables the use of level 4 spellcraft: Rain and Arrow.

Ventriloquism.Description: Spellcraft abilities will also affect any magic cast by allies during the same turn.

Spellcraft Lv 5.Description: Enables the use of level 5 spellcraft: Nova.

Diabolism Lv 1.Description: Summon Asmodeus and wield the power of level 1 diabolism: Lust and Thundaja . Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scroll.

Awakening.Description: Raises the maximum attainable job level from 10 to 11. Note that once learned, level 11 job abilities may still be used even if Awakening is removed.

Diabolism Lv 2.Description: Summon Beelzebub and wield the power of level 2 diabolism: Gluttony and Acid Breath. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scroll.

Diabolism Lv 3.Description: Summon Mammon and wield the power of level 3 diabolism: Avarice and Blizzaja . Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scroll.

Diabolism Lv 4.Description: Summon Belphegor and wield the power of level 4 diabolism: Sloth and Firaja . Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scroll.

Diabolism Lv 5.Description: Summon Satan and wield the power of level 5 diabolism: Wrath and Three Blades. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scroll.

Echo.Description: Upon casting a spell, have a 25% chance of casting the same spell a second time with no MP or BP cost.

Diabolism Lv 6.Description: Summon Leviathan and wield the power of level 6 diabolism: Envy and Consume Life. Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scroll.

Diabolism Lv 7.Description: Summon Lucifer and wield the power of level 7 diabolism: Pride and Aeroja . Note that these cannot be used without the appropriate scroll.

Obliterate.Description: Cause instant death at the start of battle to targets twenty or more levels lower than yours. Battle rewards including pg, experience, JP, and items will be obtained as usual. Bosses and certain special foes are immune to this effect. *If even a single foe is defeated by this effect, the consecutive battle challenge will not be available.

Diabolism Lv 8.Description: Enables the use of level 8 diabolism: Disguise.
